english.title: Pilot of aircraft flying in contravention of regulations fail to cause aircraft to leave the area as required
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), who became aware that the aircraft was flying in contravention of a regulation which had been made for the reason of national defence or another reason affecting the public interest, failed to cause the aircraft to leave the area to which the regulations related, namely **(..SPECIFY AREA..), by flying to the least possible extent over that area and without beginning to descend while over that area
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 239(5) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
